chapter: Los Angeles: Roy Milton and Central Avenue
title: Northwest and Canadian tour with Fields
summary: Club Alabam ended, then Portland, Seattle and Victoria, where Canadian audiences knew his name.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But anyway, we played the Club Alabam, and I got around to meet several musicians and hear several different groups and what have you. This was 1944. I came here around about October or November of 1944 to work the Club Alabam. And we stayed in there for...oh, we stayed in there until after Christmas really. Because the first of the year, we left and went to Portland, Oregon, and then we played Seattle, and we played Victoria, British Columbia, up in Canada -- we played Victoria, which was nice...

That was quite an experience, because the Canadian people were so aware of the musicians and the music that came from America, and it was kind of astounding that people walked up to me and called me by my name, way up in Canada, you know...! I said, "Wow!" If you did anything at all, they knew about you, you know, up there at the dance... And they really, really appreciated the music, you know.
